LanguageData.MH_HideAll_Desc: Hats, helmets and masks are not drawn on any pawn (they are still worn and still protect). Hair shows as if nothing was on the head.
LanguageData.MH_HairIntro: Hair under each headgear. Click a button to switch: like the game → show hair → hide hair.
LanguageData.MH_GameHides: The game hides hair under this.
LanguageData.MH_GameShows: The game shows hair under this.
